claim_summary.detail: the report's summary line is - The live-minus-node-local median difference is 54.469 s, and 100 % of it is attributed to two named components. It matches the table and the bullets beneath it: the Headline table gives live median 71.657 s and node-local (empty-crew) median 17.188 s, whose difference is 54.469 s; the two component bullets give 20.850 s (38.3 %) and 33.619 s (61.7 %), which sum to 54.469 s (100 %). 71.657 - 17.188 = 54.469 and 20.850 + 33.619 = 54.469 both hold.

claims.detail: ranked finding 1 is the headline live-minus-node-local median difference 54.469 s. Its command is run_arm.sh driving cold_roadmap_arm.py, run from the reviewed run directory. It cannot be run as cited: the mounts documents it names (mounts-live.json, mounts-A.json) and the node-local copies (home-local, copies/A-docs) under /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261017T065504837743-the-live-cold-roadmap-is-attributed were removed by the run itself, as its report states. Re-running the exact cited command reports mounts_unreadable=FileNotFoundError(2, ...) with docs_dir=None and a zero-doc read (call=roadmap seconds=0.006 ... sprints=0 for the node-local arm; the live arm 64.015 s with sprints=0), so neither the live median 71.657 s nor the node-local median 17.188 s can be reproduced. What survives (the per-run logs) only confirms the medians as arithmetic: live 64.081, 71.657, 81.173 -> 71.657; empty-crew 17.188, 16.244, 22.057 -> 17.188.

ranked finding 2 is the crew-state component 20.850 s (38.3 %). Re-running the scripts that produce the cited profile diffs - merge_profiles.py over logs/profiles/{L1,L2,L3,A4,A5,A6}-run1.prof, then profile_diff.py over the two merged dumps - reproduces the evidence exactly: mcp_views.section_attempts_by_plan cumulative 70.97 s live against 0.02 s node-local (the report states 70.97 s vs 0.02 s) and ledger._read_run 52.06 s over 24,894 calls live against 0.00 s over 0 calls node-local (the report states 24,894 live and 0 node-local); runs.parse_stream_line 874,000 calls live against 0 node-local and ledger.serialize_run 15,852 against 0 also reproduce. The 20.850 s component is the median difference 38.038 s (node-local with the live crew state) minus 17.188 s (node-local with an empty crew home).

ranked finding 3 is the docs-on-GPFS component 33.619 s (61.7 %). The component reproduces: profile_diff.py over the surviving merges gives live_total_seconds=71.657 local_total_seconds=38.038 difference_seconds=33.619, i.e. 71.657 - 38.038 = 33.619. However the report's per-function GPFS table does not match the file the report attributes it to. The report's prose says the table's node-local column is the empty-crew-home arm whose merged profile was ranked against the live one in logs/profile-diff.txt. The table states posix.scandir node-local 3.41 s and 76,335 calls, pathlib.read_text 1.30 s and 6,699 calls, glob.scandir 4.46 s and 76,293 calls, and sprint_liveness 0.87 s. logs/profile-diff.txt (live vs empty-crew) carries different figures: posix.scandir 2.31 s and 74,475 calls, read_text 0.79 s and 4,608 calls, scandir 3.10 s and 74,475 calls, sprint_liveness 0.01 s. The table's stated figures are what logs/profile-diff-with-crew.txt carries: posix.scandir 3.41 s and 76,335 calls, read_text 1.30 s and 6,699 calls, scandir 4.46 s and 76,293 calls, sprint_liveness 0.87 s. So the node-local column of the GPFS table is the with-crew arm's, not the empty-crew arm the prose names.
